status: complete - three sheets rendered, validate.py passed
author: Claude Opus (claude-opus-5-5), sole designer/visual author
concept: Spur castle on an irregular rock lip: polygonal 8-sided curtain that follows the ground, split by a diagonal cross wall into a LOWER WARD (garrison/lists/stables/smithy, entered by a bent approach to a twin-D gatehouse in the SE face) and an UPPER INNER COURT (feast court, kitchen yard, well, herb garden). The residence is an L-shaped range hinged on a round DONJON at the NW high point: Great Hall range along the north curtain (Bodiam-style screens passage -> buttery / service passage / pantry -> double-hearth two-storey kitchen), private wing running south along the west curtain. Postern + cliff stair on the west (Harlech water-gate idea).
differences_from_v1: no 36x20 rectangle and no four-corner-tower keep: L-range + single round donjon hinge
no rectangular bailey: irregular polygonal curtain with towers of varied size at angles
two wards with a second (inner) gate instead of one open yard with two ruin shells
approach is bent along the SE wall, not axial to the front door
courtyard has purposes: muster/lists, stables, smithy, barracks / feast court, kitchen yard, well, herb garden, postern
